The earlier answer failed because "Out-of-Network 30% coinsurance" appears several times on page 7. The fix is to read the Outpatient X-rays row's own column straight down. That text is "In-Network $50 copay * Out-of-Network 30% coinsurance", and it appears only once, so I used it as the quote.

The X-ray quote is one table column (the right-hand one) read straight down, which is allowed. It must include the asterisk or else skip it, and I can't skip it without mixing text. So I used the full string with the asterisk. The service name sits in a different column and can't be joined to it, so I left it out.

Whether "In-Network $50 copay * Out-of-Network 30% coinsurance" is unique on the page: the lab and diagnostic rows have different text before it, so it is unique.
